articles.text: JUAN: Son casi las tres, José.
JUAN: It's almost three o'clock, José.
JOSÉ: Tienes razón, vamos. A esta hora no hay mucho movimiento.
JOSÉ: You're right, let's go. At this hour there isn't much activity.
JUAN: Do you have yesterday's paper?
JOSÉ: Sí, aquí está. Veamos los anuncios.
JOSÉ: Yes, here it is. Let's look at the ads.
JOSÉ: Sí, aquí hay uno: 'Apartamento de tres cuartos, amueblado, agua, luz; doscientos al mes.'
JOSÉ: Yes, here's one: 'Three-room apartment, furnished, water, electricity; two hundred a month.'
JUAN: No me conviene, demasiado grande.
JUAN: It doesn't suit me, too big.
